**The third release candidate:** what 2.2.0 will be unless a blocker turns up. It ships
inside [HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.2),
and you can also install it on its own over 2.1.0, 2.2.0-beta.1 or 2.2.0-rc.1. (2.2.0-rc.2
was tagged but never released; rc.3 is that plus the Ioniq 5 on 260903.)

**It needs HMG-API 1.1.0** (its betas and release candidates count). On HMG-API 1.0.2,
update HMG-API first; 2.2.0-rc.1 is the last wireless release for 1.0.x.

## What's new since 2.2.0-rc.1

- **Wireless CarPlay no longer drops after about a minute on some phones.** At the start of
  a session the stock CarPlay app disconnected the phone's whole Bluetooth link, as it does
  for wired CarPlay, and some phones then ended the wireless session about a minute later.
  The link now stays up while wireless CarPlay runs (wired CarPlay is unchanged). Thanks to
  conorlmcbride, who found it and drove it for 15 minutes and more with no drop (#5, #2).
  On the Niro EV, Carnival and Palisade, whose hook maps came from Car Reports older than
  HMG-API 1.1.0, this fix stays off until a newer Car Report maps it; everything else works
  as in rc.1.
- **The US Ioniq 5 (2023 on) on 260903 is supported.** It no longer says "isn't for this
  head unit". Its CarPlay libraries already take Wi-Fi sessions, so the mod changes less
  there; Android Auto's turn-by-turn, wireless CarPlay audio and rc.1's longer wait for a
  CarPlay video frame work as on 260507. Thanks to joelsmith for the stock checksums
  (HMG-API #1).

Everything new since 2.1.0 is in [2.2.0-rc.1's notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.1).

## What to test

- **Wireless CarPlay for 5 minutes or more**, on a drive or parked: it stays connected, with
  audio and calls. HMG-API's log should say "Bluetooth kept up for wireless CarPlay".
- Phone calls during a wireless CarPlay session, and Bluetooth audio after it ends.
- Wired CarPlay still connects as before.
- Wireless Android Auto, as for rc.1.
- **Ioniq 5 on 260903:** the mod installs without the "isn't for this head unit" warning;
  wireless CarPlay with music, Siri and a call; wireless Android Auto with turn-by-turn on
  the cluster. A Car Report afterwards helps.

## Known issues

- On-ramps with the car's-own-format setting still show the projection icon, so the AR HUD
  doesn't animate at them (#30).
- Left-hand-traffic roundabouts (#12) and the CarPlay picture recovery after a freeze (#16)
  aren't in 2.2.0.

## Going back

To 2.2.0-rc.1 (or 2.1.0): remove the mod in the HMG-API app and apply, then put the older zip
(`wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.1.zip` from [its release](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.1))
in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick and Check USB updates. Over adb, `hmgapid engine install
<zip> --force` installs it directly.

## Reporting

An [issue here](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/issues/new/choose) with
your car, head unit software (e.g. 260507), HMG-API version and this mod's version, your
phone, how long the session lasted, and a Car Report from the HMG-API app if you can.
